title: 第4章 进山，箭术显威
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
“春税？”

    大夏王朝各类税赋多的吓人，人丁税，田税只是最基本的。

    此外还有猎税，柴税，盐税，井税，矿税。

    去年的时候，新冒出来了秋税，冬税。

    现在连年都没过，竟然出了个什么春税。

    可是……

    家中现在连顿干饭都吃不起了，哪有多余的银钱去交税。

    “陆二郎，老子跟你说话，你特么在这装什么傻！”

    见陆林迟迟不说话，孙友成顿时来了脾气。

    陆林抬眼，面无表情的看着对方。

    “没钱。”

    “没钱？呵呵，没钱也行，那就去北面修长城，修三年，可以给你们家免税三年。”

    孙友成笑的肆无忌惮。

    他身边的两个跟班，也在这时候凑热闹。

    “孙哥，陆二郎家没钱，可还有地呢。”

    “对对对，我记得当年陆大虎可是急公好义，啧啧，灾年救了不少人家呢。”

    确有此事。

    陆大虎活着的时候，打猎的本事一等一。

    手中银钱自然不少。

    遇到了荒年，灾年，他都愿意借钱给村子里的人。

    有些人还不上钱，就把地抵过来。

    陆大虎也不会让人吃亏，往往还会再补些银钱。

    久而久之，陆大虎家的地都攒下来快三十亩。

    在这南山村之中，也能算得上排名前三的小地主。

    “地？”

    孙友成冷笑一声，“就陆家那几亩地，老子可看不上眼。”

    “陆二郎，三天之内，把银子交上来，不然就不是老子跟你说话，镇上的衙役大人，会亲自来你家收税。”

    孙友成一甩袖子，带着两个跟班离开。

    王权不下乡。

    村上的一切经济，政务都是交给村正来执行操作。

    既能保证效率，又能多一层缓冲。

    大夏从立国起，就是如此。

    可这也养成了村正在村内的绝对权威。

    例如眼前的孙家。

    身后，脚步声响起。

    “小叔，怎么办，要不，要不还是让你大哥回来，他在镇上……”

    “不必。”

    梁心兰话没说完，就被陆林打断。

    “嫂嫂，这事我会想办法，你不用担心。”

    梁心兰却没有听进去。

    陆林拍了拍梁心兰的肩膀，“嫂嫂放心，三日之内，我定能弄到银子。”

    手上微微用力，陆林给了梁心兰一个坚定的眼神，拿上自己的弓箭转身离去。

    “嫂嫂，把门关好了。”

    陆林扬长而去。
content_en:
"Spring tax?"

The Great Xia Dynasty had an astonishing amount of various taxes. The capita tax and the land tax were just the most basic ones.

In addition, there are hunting taxes, firewood taxes, salt taxes, well taxes, and mineral taxes.

Last year, autumn taxes and winter taxes emerged.

Now that the New Year has not even passed, there is a spring tax.

But...

Now the family can't even afford a meal, so there is no extra money to pay taxes.

"Lu Erlang, I'm talking to you, why are you pretending to be stupid here!"

Seeing that Lu Lin didn't speak for a long time, Sun Youcheng suddenly lost his temper.

Lu Lin raised his eyes and looked at the other party expressionlessly.

"No money."

"No money? Haha, it's okay if you don't have money. Then go north and build the Great Wall. If you build it for three years, your family will be tax-free for three years."

Sun Youcheng smiled unscrupulously.

The two followers beside him also joined in the fun at this time.

"Brother Sun, Lu Erlang's family has no money, but they still have land."

"Yes, yes, yes, I remember that Lu Dahu was very eager for justice and righteousness. Tsk, tsk, he saved many families during the disaster years."

This is indeed the case.

When Lu Dahu was alive, his hunting skills were second to none.

Naturally, there is a lot of money in hand.

In times of famine and disaster, he was willing to lend money to people in the village.

Some people use their land as a mortgage even if they don't pay the money.

Lu Dahu will not let others suffer, and will often make up some extra money.

Over time, Lu Dahu's family accumulated nearly 30 acres of land.

In this Nanshan Village, he can also be regarded as the top three small landowners.

"Earth?"

Sun Youcheng sneered, "Just the few acres of the Lu family's land, I don't like it."

"Lu Erlang, hand over the money within three days, otherwise I won't be talking to you, and the town's government officials will personally come to your house to collect taxes."

Sun Youcheng flicked his sleeves and left with his two followers.

Royal power does not go to the countryside.

All economic and government affairs in the village are handed over to Muramasa.

It can not only ensure efficiency, but also provide an extra layer of buffering.

This has been the case since the founding of Daxia.

But this also created the village's absolute authority within the village.

For example, the Sun family in front of us.

Behind him, footsteps sounded.

"Uncle, what should I do? Or let your eldest brother come back. He is in town..."

"No need."

Before Liang Xinlan finished speaking, she was interrupted by Lu Lin.

"Sister-in-law, I will find a solution for this matter, you don't have to worry."

Liang Xinlan didn't listen.

Lu Lin patted Liang Xinlan on the shoulder, "Sister-in-law, don't worry, I will definitely get the money within three days."

With a slight exertion on his hands, Lu Lin gave Liang Xinlan a firm look, picked up his bow and arrow, and turned around to leave.

"Sister-in-law, close the door."

Lu Lin walked away.
